developerNotes: v40 re-read the live New+Pending gate: 347 rows = 281 New / 66 Pending inside a 400-row open bucket that also holds 53 Reopen rows (all system status 10, excluded by displayStatusName).

Movement this cycle: 4 arrivals (UFN-70689, UFN-70692, UFN-70694, UFN-70703) against 6 departures (UFN-70680, UFN-70681, UFN-70682, UFN-70683, UFN-70684, UFN-70685). The eligible working set moved 320 -> 318.

Departures are enumerated, not inferred: UFN-70680, UFN-70681, UFN-70682, UFN-70683, UFN-70684, UFN-70685 were all in the v39 gate and are absent from the live v40 gate. They are the 2026-09-13 Appointment Watch / Dropship daily-report batch that closed once its report cycle completed. Their leaving the gate is a status outcome in Ticket Ops, not an exclusion applied by this pipeline.

The 24 billing / UF Billing / storage / handling invoice-family exclusions and the 5 source-backed conversation duplicates were all re-confirmed present in the live gate (24/24 and 5/5). Deduplication still collapses only CASE/DN conversation identity, never subject text. The exclusion set is unchanged this cycle; six of the 24 carry no billing wording in their titles, which is exactly why the explicit ticket-number list is used rather than a title heuristic.

19 live closeFlag=true records remain in the eligible set (gate-wide 20, of which UFN-65196 is billing-excluded). closeFlag stays evidence-only and is never an eligibility gate; all 20 sit on Pending rows that are system-OPEN.

The UFN-67030 citation remains stale: authoritative Ticket Ops status is Solved (displayStatusSystemStatus 20, closedTime 09/01/2026), so it is out of the gate on status, not on closeFlag. The rule stands and is better evidenced by the live closeFlag=true Pending rows (UFN-70443, UFN-70412, UFN-70304, UFN-70243, UFN-70130, UFN-69781).
Time-derived fields (ageHours, ageDays, action buckets, freshness) were recomputed at the new refresh instant; 120 existing records crossed a whole-day age boundary.

Status-name audit: the display-status dictionary actually in use in this department is New(11), Pending(6), Reopen(1), Solved(2). There are no "Open"-named rows, so the "New / Open / Pending" inclusion rule resolves to New + Pending, with the Reopen cohort excluded by name.
No Pending sub-status breakdown is published: all 66 Pending rows carry a single display status "Pending" (id 6).

Customer Health covers every customer visible in the eligible ticket set (configured roster/aliases remain supplemental only; public/data/structured_list.json carries an empty roster) and still yields 0 Healthy because every eligible record is UFN-tagged.
Outlook context was refreshed for this cycle and remains supplemental and non-blocking: it never contributes to ticket counts, queue, buckets, customer health or SLA metrics.

exclusions.candidateOverlapNote: Seven C.H. Robinson appointment pairs share an identical source load number (original request plus ' - Follow Up' re-send). They are retained in the eligible set and flagged here because the dashboard's configured deduplication rule collapses only source-backed conversation identity (CASE/DN), never subject- or load-text similarity. Ticket Ops confirms they are the same load; the ticket count would fall from 310 to 303 if the rule were extended to load-number identity. Awaiting a business ruling.
